title: Wick Liquor Boulevard Shattered 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Wick Liquor Boulevard Shattered takes the legendary Boulevard profile and gives it an icy twist. It features the same vibrant Mardi Gras fruit punch and Malibu Loganberry pulp notes as the original, but finishes with Wick Liquor’s signature "shattered" cold effect. This delivers a sharp, frozen exhale that invigorates the senses while keeping the fruit flavours front and center. Manufactured in Staffordshire, Wick Liquor is a premium boutique brand famous for its "big block" approach to flavour, offering some of the most distinct and high-quality blends on the market. This Nic Salt version offers the same legendary taste in a smooth format. With a 50% VG / 50% PG blend, this e-liquid is perfectly balanced for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping. It is designed to pair flawlessly with low-wattage pod kits and starter vape kits, producing discreet vapour and exceptional flavour clarity. The nicotine salt formulation ensures a smooth throat hit and rapid satisfaction. Wick Liquor Nic Salts are available in 10mg and 20mg strengths. This 10ml e-liquid is TPD-compliant and features a childproof cap and tamper-evident seal. Simple, reliable, and ready to use — perfect for refillable vape kit and vape starter kit UK alike.
